description: Use when preparing for Japan's Labor and Social Security Attorney examination (社会保険労務士試験 / 社労士) — eligibility requirements, the fill-in-the-blank (選択式) and multiple-choice (択一式) parts with per-subject minimum scores, labour law, workers' compensation, employment insurance, health insurance and pensions, keeping up with yearly amendments and official figures. Also use when writing or verifying practice questions grounded in these statutes.
